visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler boy with short brown hair is seated in a grey and white car safety seat inside a moving vehicle. He wears a white bib over a black and white long-sleeved shirt. Outside the window, a green, blurry landscape suggests travel. He gestures with his small hands, looking around with wide, curious eyes. (2) The setting remains the car interior, but the boy is now focused on a brown steamed bun he holds with both hands. He examines the texture of the bread before bringing it to his mouth for a bite. The lighting is natural and bright, coming through the car window, highlighting his facial features. (3) The scene transitions to an outdoor city street. The boy, now wearing a white ghost costume with black skeleton patterns, walks between two adult women holding their hands. A yellow taxi and several motorcycles are visible in the background against a brick building. (4) The boy is inside a brightly lit event venue decorated with colorful circles and pastel-colored walls. He holds two maracas—one green and one orange—and shakes them enthusiastically. Other children and adults are partially visible, blurred in the background, creating a busy community atmosphere. (5) The boy stands in a dim corner of the room, facing a white wall. He leans his forehead against the surface, appearing distressed or pouting. His white poncho costume covers his back, and the shadows are deeper in this enclosed space compared to the previous scenes. (6) A woman dressed as a character with large black horns sits on the floor with the boy. She wears a black feathered outfit. Bubbles float through the air, reflecting the bright studio lighting. The boy looks upward at the bubbles with a surprised and delighted expression. (7) The final sequence takes place in an underground parking garage with yellow lines on the concrete floor. The boy stands with an adult woman, posing for photos. He makes various playful expressions, wearing white shorts and a black sweatshirt while pointing at the camera.

(3) A 'ding' bell sound effect marks a transition to the street. Ambient noise of city traffic and distant footsteps are audible beneath the music. The boy's voice rises in pitch and volume as he expresses excitement while walking outside. (4) Multiple 'bubble pop' sound effects and 'cartoon bounce' noises play as bubbles are blown. Background noise includes the chatter of several children and adults, creating a moderate crowd murmur. The BGM tempo feels energetic, matching the fast-paced visual editing. (5) A sharp 'comic impact' SFX sounds as the boy moves into the corner. His vocalizations become whiny and low-pitched, indicating distress. The BGM volume ducks slightly to emphasize his vocal emotion, though the rhythm continues. (6) A 'sparkle' SFX accompanies the appearance of the costumed character. The woman's voice is playful and melodramatic, contrasting with the toddler's softer, questioning responses. The acoustic environment has a slight indoor room resonance. (7) Rapid 'camera shutter' and 'zipper' SFX are used during the final posing montage in the garage. The BGM swells in volume, dominated by heavy bass and bright percussion. The adult's voice is heard shouting praise, exhibiting high arousal and positive valence.
